Adopter Governance Worksheet

Blastwall v3 can publish as an upstream reference exemplar while this worksheet remains pending. Organizations that adopt the pattern should complete these rows before operating stable-v3 as a local control.

Adopter Operation Rule

Do not operate stable-v3 as an organization-owned control while any role above is pending. This worksheet is not required to publish the upstream reference exemplar.
